steps.title: Travel to Zanik
steps.hints: Try go_to 'Zanik' first, then 'Bramblemead Valley'. The valley is east of Temple Woods in Brynmoor. If neither name resolves, ask Zezima for directions. Stay with Zezima and avoid fights, since I have no gear.

events.description: Start Goblin Diplomacy: walk to Zanik on the ridge in Bramblemead Valley, which overlooks the Whispering Swamp. This plan covers only that first leg.
events.explanation: I'm not looking up Zanik's coordinates. The plan doesn't need them. The go_to tool takes a place or id by name, so it can find Zanik or Bramblemead Valley itself. The valley is also described as east of Temple Woods in Brynmoor. If the name doesn't resolve, the step falls back to asking Zezima, who is standing next to me. I'm also not looking up the later quest steps now. They depend on what Zanik says when the quest starts, and the wiki lookup only returned the intro and the reward (Goblin war banner). I will plan them after the quest has begun. I carry no gear and the area is power level 2, so this trip is marked risky. I can't talk to NPCs with my tools, so that gap is listed below.
